name: manage-sandbox-allowlist
description: Add or remove CLI/tool patterns in Claude Code's sandbox permissions allowlist and denylist in settings.json. TRIGGER when: a Bash command is blocked by the sandbox, or the user asks to allow/deny a command, "add X to the allowlist", "stop asking permission for Y", or "sandbox blocked this". DO NOT TRIGGER for: general settings.json edits unrelated to permissions (use update-config).
